name: Viaplay Group AB (publ)
summary: Viaplay Group AB (publ), listed under the symbol NENTY, functions as a prominent entertainment provider and streaming service, reaching audiences across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and other global regions. At the heart of its digital offerings is Viaplay, an online video streaming platform that delivers a diverse range of content. This includes live sports, exclusive original series, documentaries, films, international television releases, classic shows, and children's animation and series. The company also provides Viafree, a platform that grants viewers access to a variety of complimentary content. Beyond streaming, Viaplay Group oversees an extensive array of linear television channels. This includes the premium "V sport, series & film" channels, dedicated to offering top-tier entertainment. Its commercial channels comprise TV3, TV6 (targeting young male audiences), TV8 (focusing on procedural dramas), and TV10 (broadcasting sporting events and documentaries). Additional channels such as Viasat4 and TV3+ cater to young male demographics, while TV3 PULS features procedural series alongside cooking and lifestyle programming. Sports fans can tune into TV3 Sport, and TV3 MAX presents a selection of comedy and drama series. The group further extends its reach through a substantial portfolio of radio stations, encompassing popular channels like Rix FM, Bandit Rock, Power Hit Radio, Star FM, and the 'P' series stations (P4 Lyden av Norge, P5 Hits, P6 Rock, P7 Klem, P8 Pop, P9 Retro, P10 Country). Online audio services include the NRJ online TV channel, Bandit's online station, and the I LIKE RADIO music service, which also features news segments, talk shows, and contests. To fuel its content ecosystem, Viaplay Group operates Viaplay Studios, a network of production companies responsible for creating original and animated material. The company also generates revenue by offering advertising services across its television channels, radio stations, and streaming platforms. Incorporated in 2017 and based in Stockholm, Sweden, the company adopted its current name, Viaplay Group AB (publ), in May 2022, having previously been known as Nordic Entertainment Group AB (publ).
